item.text: The helper module has no `isFromProton` yet, and the list directory has no `VerifiedBadge.tsx`. I’m checking the element interfaces before adding the shared predicate so it works for every type in `Element`.

`IsProton` is absent from the local message and conversation types, so I added it as optional on both and carried it into encrypted search messages. The helper now returns `true` only for the numeric value `1`; I added tests for both element kinds.
